snippet.title: Artillery Miner Coming Soon !!!
snippet.description: Artillery miner is an incremental game where you mine large blocks using weapons check out the steam link here https://store.steampowered.com/app/4391380/Artillery_Miner/ . Thanks to everyone supporting the game on steam and who have helped me reach the final stages of development, I cannot wait for the full release.
